answer.origin: Robert Izquierdo, The Motley Fool, published 2026-08-01 (third-party media view, tier third_party_view). The Nvidia figures are attributed to company filings with data as of July 31, 2026. The Nvidia $91B next-quarter forecast is attributed to 'the company' without a named document. The Google Cloud Q2 figures have no stated original source in the article.
answer.note: For NVDA, this article is a secondary media comparison. Its central claim is Alphabet's Google Cloud Q2 2026 revenue of $24.8B (+82% y/y) and backlog above $0.5 trillion (up from $462B in Q1). That supports, at most, an inference that AI cloud demand is strong at a major hyperscaler. It does not establish NVDA orders, revenue, or market share, because the Google Cloud figures belong to Alphabet. The article also states that Alphabet is among Nvidia's customers, with no purchase amount, period, or contract terms given, so it is a customer-relationship lead only. The article's Nvidia forecast of $91B for the next quarter after the $81.6B quarter ended April 2026 is a company-stated forecast, and its date and source document are not identified here. Read together, the article suggests a conditional view: if the cited Nvidia guidance and hyperscaler demand figures are accurate, they are consistent with continued AI-accelerator demand, but the article does not separately verify either. The quarterly revenue series in the article is listed for both companies in one mixed table, so individual values cannot be assigned to Nvidia with certainty from this text alone.
limitations: The Google Cloud revenue and backlog figures belong to Alphabet and do not establish NVDA orders, revenue, or backlog.
The Alphabet-as-Nvidia-customer statement has no disclosed amount, period, product scope, or contract terms.
The $91B next-quarter Nvidia forecast has no identified source document or statement date beyond the article's publication date.
The original source of the Google Cloud Q2 figures is not stated; the article does not name a filing or release.
The quarterly revenue table mixes Nvidia and Alphabet periods without clear labeling, so per-company values cannot be confirmed from this article alone.
The article's reported Nvidia quarter ending April 26, 2026 net margin of 72% is not tied to a cited filing in the text.
follow_up: Retrieve Nvidia's most recent quarterly results release and Form 10-Q to confirm the $81.6B quarter figure and check whether the $91B next-quarter outlook appears in company guidance.

Retrieve Alphabet's Q2 2026 earnings release to verify Google Cloud revenue ($24.8B, +82%) and backlog (over $0.5T, up from $462B), and confirm whether the figures refer to the same definition as prior periods.
Search Alphabet's 10-Q and earnings call materials for any disclosure of Nvidia as a supplier, including purchase amounts or capacity commitments, to test the customer-relationship claim.
